This '''Trandoshan''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] working for [[Attuma Duum]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] [[Skirmish in the Cavamina Minor cantina|attempted to arrest]] Duum, but she was forced to flee. This [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], wearing modified [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|Clone trooper armor]] and carrying a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], joined [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]], Duum's chief of security, and other mercenaries to hunt down Secura on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Cavamina Minor]]. They cornered Secura, but she ran; the rogue [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Shon-Ju]] and his students intervened and attacked the mercenaries. This Trandoshan was knocked aside by a [[Unidentified Zabrak (Force user)|Zabrak]]. Sabat fled before Shon-Ju could engage him in personal combat, allowing Shon-Ju to treat Secura's injuries.

==Behind the scenes==
This individual appears in a scene in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''.
